decisions.statement: A song is the composition rather than the release it was carried on.
A remix, a live take and an acoustic cut are recordings of the one song.
A title is matched to a song under the artist the release names.
A title a song holds whole is matched before anything is dropped from it.
A bracketed aside holding a credit or a version word is dropped from a title.
A tail after a dash holding a credit or a version word is dropped from a title.
An aside or tail holding neither a credit nor a version word is part of the title.
Two titles are one title where they hold the same letters and digits.
A title left with nothing by what was dropped keeps itself instead.
No title is matched to a song of another artist.
A title holding no letter and no digit is matched to no song.

definition: the song a released title is a recording of
